summary: Four games were played on Thursday. Cade Cunningham scored a career-high 52 points with 11 assists in Detroit's 144-140 double-overtime win at Washington, a game that needed a Trae Young three in the last second of regulation and an AJ Dybantsa jumper in the last seconds of the first overtime to get there. Minnesota's 133-94 win over Dallas was the night's largest margin at 39 points, and Philadelphia and Phoenix both came back at home.

games.headline: Sixers erase 17-point hole to beat Raptors
games.story: Toronto led 33-16 late in the first quarter and still led by nine after one, but Philadelphia answered with 36 points in the second quarter to tie the game 60-60 at halftime. The 76ers broke an 85-85 tie with 11 straight points late in the third, never trailed again and led by 15 in the fourth. Tyrese Maxey scored 27 with eight assists and made 10 of 12 free throws, VJ Edgecombe added 15 points, eight rebounds and eight assists, and Anfernee Simons hit five of his six threes. RJ Barrett scored 31 with 14 rebounds and Immanuel Quickley added 26 for Toronto, which did not have Kawhi Leonard or Scottie Barnes; Philadelphia did not have LeBron James.

games.headline: Cunningham's 52 lifts Pistons in double OT
games.story: Cade Cunningham scored a career-high 52 points with 11 assists and no turnovers, making 17 of his 18 free throws, and Detroit survived two late tying shots. Trae Young hit a 29-footer with 1.1 seconds left in regulation to make it 121-121, and AJ Dybantsa's pull-up with 2.8 seconds left in the first overtime tied it at 132. The Pistons went ahead for good at 135-132 in the second overtime after a game with 20 lead changes and 13 ties. Ausar Thompson posted his first career triple-double with 17 points, 11 rebounds and 11 assists, while Washington got 37 points and 14 assists from Young, 30 from Alex Sarr and 30 points with 15 rebounds from Anthony Davis.

games.headline: Timberwolves bury Mavericks by 39
games.story: Minnesota went ahead for good late in the first quarter, led 67-52 at halftime and then outscored Dallas 36-17 in the third quarter. The Timberwolves shot 57.8 percent, made 15 threes and handed out 33 assists, and their lead reached 44 points in the fourth. Bones Hyland scored 24 off the bench on 5-of-6 shooting from three with eight assists, LaMelo Ball added 22 points, nine assists and six threes, and Ayo Dosunmu scored 18. Dallas shot 37.2 percent and was led by Zaccharie Risacher's 22 points; Minnesota played without Anthony Edwards and Donte DiVincenzo.

games.headline: Booker's 30 holds off Hornets rally
games.story: Phoenix led by 17 in the second quarter, then Charlotte won the third quarter 26-17 to lead 76-72 going to the fourth. The Suns scored six in a row to go ahead for good at 81-79 and built it back to 92-86, and when Charlotte got within 97-95 with 21 seconds left Phoenix closed the game with four free throws. Devin Booker scored 30 on 12-of-20 shooting with seven assists, Dillon Brooks added 15 and Collin Gillespie 13. Charlotte committed 25 turnovers to Phoenix's seven, got 21 points from Coby White and 16 from Naz Reid, and played without Brandon Miller, Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder.
